name: Biology
description: Biology for Ordinary and Advanced Secondary Education, Form I-VI. Covers cell biology, genetics, ecology, human physiology, plants, microorganisms, biochemistry and evolution.

subtopics.title: Concept of Biology
outcomes: Define Biology and basic concepts and terminologies

subtopics.title: Importance of Studying Biology
outcomes: Explain the importance of studying Biology

subtopics.title: Relationship between Biology and other Scientific Fields
outcomes: Describe the relationship between Biology and other scientific fields

subtopics.title: Common Biology Laboratory Apparatus, Equipment and Other Resources
outcomes: Identify common Biology laboratory apparatus, equipment, and resources
State the uses of each apparatus and proper care

subtopics.title: Basic Skills in Scientific Studies
outcomes: Describe basic skills in scientific studies (observation, recording, measurement)

subtopics.title: Scientific Methods
outcomes: Describe the steps of the scientific method

subtopics.title: Simple Biological Experiments
outcomes: Conduct simple biological experiments and record observations accurately

subtopics.title: The Cell
outcomes: Define a cell and describe its structure
Identify cell organelles and their functions

subtopics.title: Types of Cells
outcomes: Distinguish between plant and animal cells

subtopics.title: Cell Organization
outcomes: Explain the concept of cell organization
Identify levels of cell organization (cell, tissue, organ)

subtopics.title: Concept of Classification
outcomes: Define classification and explain its importance

subtopics.title: Classification Systems
outcomes: Describe classification systems and the hierarchy of classification
Identify the five kingdoms of classification

subtopics.title: Major Groups of Living Things
outcomes: Identify major groups of living things and their characteristics

subtopics.title: Binomial Nomenclature
outcomes: Explain the rules of binomial nomenclature
Give examples of scientific names and state the importance of scientific naming

topics.title: VIRUSES AND MAJOR GROUPS OF LIVING THINGS

subtopics.title: Viruses
outcomes: Describe the structure and reproduction of viruses
Identify the effects of viruses on living things

subtopics.title: Kingdom Monera
outcomes: Describe characteristics of Kingdom Monera and identify examples

subtopics.title: Kingdom Protoctista
outcomes: Describe characteristics of Kingdom Protoctista and identify examples

subtopics.title: Kingdom Fungi
outcomes: Describe characteristics of Kingdom Fungi and identify examples

subtopics.title: Kingdom Plantae
outcomes: Describe characteristics of Kingdom Plantae and identify major divisions of plants

subtopics.title: Classes of the division Angiospermophyta
outcomes: Identify classes of Angiospermophyta and their characteristics

subtopics.title: Kingdom Animalia
outcomes: Describe characteristics of Kingdom Animalia and identify major phyla

subtopics.title: Concept of Nutrition
outcomes: Define nutrition and explain its importance

subtopics.title: Essential and Non-essential Elements in Plants
outcomes: Distinguish essential and non-essential elements and identify essential elements for plant growth

subtopics.title: Photosynthesis
outcomes: Explain the process of photosynthesis and state its equation

subtopics.title: Structure of the Leaf in Relation to Photosynthesis
outcomes: Describe the structure of a leaf and how it is adapted for photosynthesis

subtopics.title: Importance of Photosynthesis
outcomes: Explain the importance of photosynthesis to plants, animals, and the ecosystem

subtopics.title: Nutrients
outcomes: state the sources and functions of food nutrients

subtopics.title: Balanced diet
outcomes: explain the importance of a balanced diet

subtopics.title: Nutritional requirements for different groups
outcomes: describe nutritional needs of different age groups
explain special nutritional needs of pregnant and lactating women

subtopics.title: Nutritional deficiencies and disorders
outcomes: describe symptoms and prevention of nutritional disorders

subtopics.title: Properties of food nutrients
outcomes: describe the physical and chemical properties of food nutrients

subtopics.title: The digestion process
outcomes: describe the structure of the human digestive system
explain the process of digestion in different parts of the alimentary canal

subtopics.title: Disorders and diseases of human digestive system
outcomes: identify common disorders of the digestive system
explain the causes and prevention of digestive diseases

subtopics.title: The digestive system of ruminants
outcomes: describe the structure of the digestive system in ruminants
compare digestion in ruminants and non-ruminants

topics.title: TRANSPORT OF MATERIALS IN LIVING ORGANISMS

subtopics.title: Concept of transportation of materials
outcomes: explain the importance of transport systems

subtopics.title: Ways of transportation of materials
outcomes: describe different methods of transport in organisms
explain bulk flow systems in multicellular organisms

topics.title: TRANSPORT OF MATERIALS IN FLOWERING PLANTS

subtopics.title: The vascular system
outcomes: describe the structure of xylem and phloem
explain the function of vascular tissues in transport

subtopics.title: Absorption and movement of water and mineral salts
outcomes: explain the absorption of water and minerals by roots
describe the ascent of sap in plants

subtopics.title: The mammalian heart
outcomes: describe the structure of the mammalian heart

subtopics.title: Blood vessels
outcomes: distinguish between arteries, veins and capillaries
describe the structure and function of blood vessels

subtopics.title: The blood
outcomes: describe the functions of blood components

subtopics.title: Blood groups
outcomes: explain the importance of blood grouping

subtopics.title: Blood transfusion
outcomes: explain the principles of blood transfusion

subtopics.title: Blood circulation in human beings
outcomes: explain the pathway of blood through the body

subtopics.title: Concept of gas exchange
outcomes: define gas exchange in living organisms

subtopics.title: Gas exchange in mammals
outcomes: describe the structure of the mammalian respiratory system

subtopics.title: Gas exchange in plants
outcomes: explain the role of lenticels in gas exchange

subtopics.title: Respiration in mammals
outcomes: distinguish between aerobic and anaerobic respiration
write the equations for aerobic and anaerobic respiration

subtopics.title: Infections and diseases of the respiratory system
outcomes: explain prevention and control of respiratory diseases

subtopics.title: Excretory organs and systems
outcomes: Identify excretory organs: kidneys, lungs, skin, liver
Describe the structure of the kidney and nephron

subtopics.title: Urine formation
outcomes: Describe the process of urine formation: filtration, reabsorption, secretion

subtopics.title: Kidney disorders
outcomes: Describe kidney disorders: kidney stones, kidney failure, dialysis

subtopics.title: Human reproductive system
outcomes: Describe the male and female reproductive systems
Explain the menstrual cycle and hormonal control

subtopics.title: Fertilization and development
outcomes: Describe embryonic development and the role of the placenta

subtopics.title: Reproduction in plants
outcomes: Describe sexual and asexual reproduction in plants
Describe pollination and its types: self, cross, wind, insect

subtopics.title: Reproductive health
outcomes: Describe STIs: HIV/AIDS, gonorrhoea, syphilis and their prevention

subtopics.title: Mendelian genetics
outcomes: Define gene, allele, genotype and phenotype
Apply monohybrid and dihybrid crosses using Punnett squares
Explain the laws of segregation and independent assortment

subtopics.title: Inheritance patterns
outcomes: Explain Mendelian and non-Mendelian inheritance: incomplete dominance, codominance, sex-linkage
Use genetic crosses to predict outcomes of inherited traits

subtopics.title: DNA and biotechnology
outcomes: Describe the structure of DNA and its role in protein synthesis
Explain genetic engineering and its applications

subtopics.title: Ecosystems
outcomes: Define ecosystem and identify its biotic and abiotic components
Describe food chains and food webs

subtopics.title: Energy flow and nutrient cycling
outcomes: Describe energy flow through ecosystems: producers, consumers, decomposers
Explain carbon, nitrogen and water cycles

subtopics.title: Environmental conservation
outcomes: Describe human activities that damage the environment: deforestation, pollution, overgrazing
Explain conservation methods: afforestation, recycling, protected areas
Describe the effects of global warming and ozone depletion

subtopics.title: Parasitism, symbiosis and commensalism
outcomes: Distinguish between parasitism, mutualism and commensalism
Identify examples of each relationship in ecosystems

subtopics.title: Adaptations
outcomes: Describe structural, physiological and behavioral adaptations of organisms

subtopics.title: Evolution
outcomes: Explain theories of evolution: Lamarckism and Darwinism

subtopics.title: Cytogenetics
outcomes: Analyze the structure and behaviour of chromosomes
Describe linkage, crossing-over and gene maps

subtopics.title: Nucleic acids and gene expression
outcomes: Explain DNA replication and transcription and translation

subtopics.title: Protein synthesis
outcomes: Trace the steps of protein synthesis and the genetic code
Describe the effects of mutations on gene products

subtopics.title: Growth in plants

Explain physiological and morphological responses of plants to stimuli

subtopics.title: Growth in animals
outcomes: Describe the role of hormones in animal growth and development

subtopics.title: Nervous coordination
outcomes: Describe the transmission of nerve impulses across synapses

subtopics.title: Chemical and sensory coordination
outcomes: Describe endocrine regulation and pheromone function

subtopics.title: Movement and locomotion
outcomes: Describe mechanisms of movement in animals and plants

subtopics.title: Gaseous exchange mechanisms
outcomes: Describe gaseous exchange in plants, insects, fish and mammals
Compare transport structures supporting gas exchange

subtopics.title: Cellular respiration
outcomes: Summarize glycolysis, the Krebs cycle and the electron transport chain
Compare aerobic and anaerobic respiration and ATP yield

subtopics.title: Respiratory diseases
outcomes: Describe causes and prevention of common respiratory diseases

subtopics.title: Excretory organs
outcomes: Describe the structure and function of excretory organs (kidney, liver, lungs, skin)
Describe the formation of urine and kidney homeostasis

subtopics.title: Homeostatic regulation
outcomes: Describe regulation of temperature, water, glucose and pH balance
Explain the role of feedback mechanisms in homeostasis

subtopics.title: Homeostatic disorders
outcomes: Describe diabetes, kidney failure, acidosis and osmoregulation disorders

subtopics.title: Nutrients, vitamins and metabolism
outcomes: Describe the classes and functions of nutrients and vitamins
Analyze metabolism, mineral nutrition and vitamins in the body

subtopics.title: Principles of nutrition in living organisms
outcomes: Compare autotrophic and heterotrophic modes of nutrition
Describe balanced diet, food preparation and preservation

subtopics.title: Plant and animal support systems
outcomes: Describe support systems in plants (turgidity, wood, fibers)
Describe support systems in animals (skeletons, hydrostatic)

subtopics.title: Transport in plants
outcomes: Describe uptake of water and minerals by roots
Explain cohesion-tension and pressure-flow hypotheses of translocation

subtopics.title: Transport in mammals
outcomes: Describe circulation of blood and lymph
Describe blood groups and systemic circulation

subtopics.title: Cardiovascular and transport disorders
outcomes: Describe hypertension, anemia and other transport disorders

subtopics.title: Enzymes and catalysis
outcomes: Describe the mechanism of enzyme action

subtopics.title: Digestion and absorption
outcomes: Trace the digestive process in the gastrointestinal tract

subtopics.title: Nutritional disorders
outcomes: Describe deficiency diseases such as kwashiorkor and marasmus

subtopics.title: Regulation of gene expression
outcomes: Explain operon models and gene regulation in prokaryotes and eukaryotes

subtopics.title: Variation, mutation and genetics defects
outcomes: Describe causes and effects of genetic chromosome defects

subtopics.title: DNA technology and genetic engineering
outcomes: Describe recombinant DNA technology and gene cloning
Discuss ethical issues of genetic engineering and biotechnology

subtopics.title: Ecosystem organization
outcomes: Describe the components and functioning of ecosystems
Describe energy flow and nutrient cycles

subtopics.title: Population ecology
outcomes: Analyze population growth models and carrying capacity
Describe population structure and sampling methods

subtopics.title: Applied ecology
outcomes: Apply ecology to land, water and field studies

subtopics.title: Reproduction in plants and animals
outcomes: Describe the reproductive structures of flowering plants

subtopics.title: Hormonal regulation of reproduction
outcomes: Explain the hormonal control of the menstrual cycle
Describe contraception and family planning methods

subtopics.title: Pregnancy and development
outcomes: Describe fertilization, implantation and embryonic development
Describe childbirth and the protection of the embryo
